cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — standing; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground; a neon-lit game arcade — holds a cup in both hands; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — lying on her left side; a far-future orbital visitor centre with a miniature rotating planetarium dome and an empty curved demonstration dais — taking a break by pretending to host the planetarium show; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — seated on a chair; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated sideways on a stool or bench; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — holds her keepsake at chest height
